about.description: Run Windows software and games on Linux
about.head: 1b16c73

body:
## What's Changed
* Fixed reading the Windows version when Wine writes diagnostics or uses stderr, including the error that stopped dependency installers.
* Fixed first-run setup when Bottles is opened with an executable or a file URL.
* Fixed repeated font refreshes after wineboot updates the fonts directory.
* Updated the Courier New font download mirror.
* Gaming bottles now check runner and kernel support before choosing NTSync.
* Added a warning when the selected runner does not support Esync.
* Bottle creation now stops if the user profile cannot be prepared.
* Fixed playtime session cleanup with statistics disabled.
* Fixed the drag overlay, importer empty state and installer resource button being rejected by Adwaita.
* Added Latvian to the language selector and updated the Swedish translation.
* Updated the experimental Soda and Office installer catalogs.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/bottlesdevs/Bottles/compare/67.6...67.7
